svg.title: Gesture lamp physical wiring with real ESP32 and MOSFET driver photographs
svg.desc: GPIO25 connects to In. The external five volt supply connects to V+. The power supply negative, ESP32 ground and driver ground share a three port connector. The LED strip connects to the driver positive and negative output terminals. USB powers the ESP32 separately.
svg.text: GDGoC UM × REC · Real component photos, with wires drawn onto the connection points
2 All three GND wires → ground connector
USB connects the laptop to the ESP32.
REC preparation: solder three driver input leads.
Use the GND, V+ and In pads; leave Out unused.
Use 22 AWG leads for the lamp power circuit.
5V lamp circuit only · Leave ESP32 5V / 3V3 pins unconnected while using USB · Board sizes enlarged for clarity
Component photography: Espressif and Adafruit · Proposed wiring layout, not a photo of a tested assembly
